mentions.name: trmnl-japanese-vocab
mentions.description: A Trmnl plugin that displays Japanese vocabulary flash cards with furigana, improving on Trmnl's native flash card plugin which lacked furigana support.
mentions.problem: The native Trmnl flash card plugin for Japanese vocabulary lacked furigana.
mentions.audience: Japanese language learners using a Trmnl device
mentions.source_excerpt: And today I knocked out an improved trmnl plugin for Japanese flash cards at my wife’s request as she liked the native one from trmnl but it lacked furigana https://github.com/simonjgreen/trmnl-japanese-vocab
